text: Working with APIs is an essential skill for modern developers. Most APIs work over HTTP, so you send requests to a server and receive responses in return. The data usually comes back in JSON format, which is easy to read and parse. Before you can access an API, you often need authentication, such as an API key, to prove who you are. Be aware of rate limits, which restrict how many requests you can make within a certain time. Finally, always include error handling in your code, because requests can fail for many reasons, and your application should respond gracefully instead of crashing.
